title: Edmund and the Orchard
author: Noor Almeida
blurb: Paloma Whitlock, a mapmaker's apprentice finishing the atlas the master died for, has spent twenty years learning which silences keep people safe. Then a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
